outcome: The anti-stall repair now covers the original execution architecture, not only GitHub Actions monitoring.
owner_impact: Ordinary Virtual Lab development may iterate only on bounded local work. GitHub Actions, deployment, remote benchmarks, Work/browser jobs, authentication and other asynchronous services are never waited on, polled or monitored by ChatGPT. Terminal CI is fire-and-forget and reports independently.
remaining_action: Resume #251 with the Authoring-shell migration in the next product-work turn. If autonomous CI reports a specific failure, diagnose that failure only in a later owner-requested turn.
technical_evidence: History correction: the synchronous self-verification-loop design was codified on 10 September 2026 at 23:50 GST, not introduced on 17 September.
Agent-side waiting on GitHub Actions is recoverable in project history by 11 September; multi-run CI waiting occurred again on 15 September.

Late 16 September added independent hazards: a browser MutationObserver self-trigger loop and a wedged smoke/deployment path; 17 September also exposed broad connector capability discovery as another stall mechanism.
AGENTS.md, CURRENT.md, PROJECT_CONTROL.md, ROUND1_ACCEPTANCE.md and EXECUTION_GRANULARITY.md now share one zero-tolerance asynchronous-boundary rule.
web/product-surface.json encodes the liveness prohibitions in machine-readable form and regression tests prevent the retired synchronous-loop wording from returning.
